title: A patrol looking for someone
text: {a} reins in a tired horse. "We're looking for an outlaw who came this way. Tall, scarred, limps. Have you seen anyone like that?" Behind a rock, off the road, a man crouches very still.

effects.text: The captain tosses you a purse.

outcomes.text: The patrol caught the outlaw by the rock, as you said.

success.text: They ride on. Behind the rock, a man breathes out.

fail.text: They don't believe you. They search the rock anyway, and find him, and look at you for a long time.
